summary.title: Florin Pop - Dev turned Indie Hacker
summary.one_liner: Florin Pop's personal site documents his indie-hacking journey toward $1M in revenue, with a log of blog posts and a table of his projects and their reported revenue.
keywords: ebook 10 ways to make money as a dev
takeaways: Florin is a developer who is building in public with a stated goal of $1,000,000 in revenue.
He reports selling his SaaS iCodeThis for $50,000 (Feb 17 post) and a $7,500 in 3 days consulting offer (Apr 3 post).
His project table lists a coding course, an eBook, a time-tracking app (Indie Action), a $1M tracking grid, and 1-on-1 consulting, with total reported revenue of $445,583.
Posts cover monthly income reports, a scrappy Twitter launch that made $1000 in 3 hours, and a 2024 review.
summary.summary: This is the homepage of Florin Pop, a developer turned indie hacker who shares his journey of building products toward $1,000,000 in revenue. It lists recent blog posts, including a consulting offer that made $7,500 in 3 days, the sale of his SaaS iCodeThis for $50,000, and monthly income reports. A projects table shows each product with its status, revenue, and launch date, totaling $445,583 in reported revenue. The page is mostly a personal update feed and project log rather than a technical tutorial.
